messages:
maria: Quick check — Starry preview cohort (Group B) final headcount? I have enablement slots tomorrow at 10am / 2pm PT. Need to lock RSVPs + who's doing the 1:1s.

alex: We have 6 seats filled, 2 pending legal. I'll nudge legal now. @sam can you confirm 1:1 capacity? :eyes:

sam: I can take 4 1:1s next week (Tue/Wed). For tomorrow's enablement I can handle the live Q&A for ~30m.

jeff: Product will prep the short troubleshooting doc and a 10m demo clip. Uploading draft here: https://redwood.internal/share/starry/demo-draft (will update).

maria: Thanks. Also: Starry asked for an infra lead on the call to cover VPC details — can we invite one?
alex: I'll ping their infra contact now. If we can't get them, jeff can cover the high-level network notes.
onboard-bot: Calendar invite created: "Starry Preview — Enablement" Tue 2024-05-14 10:00 PT. Attendees: maria, alex, sam, jeff. Invite link: https://cal.redwood.ai/ev/abcd1234

sam: Small favor — can we include a 1-page pre-read with 5 bullets (FAQ + known caveats)? I'll draft and share by EOD.
maria: Perfect. alex — once legal clears the 2 pending seats, can you send the confirmation email and include the pre-read link?
alex: Will do. Draft I plan to send: 
```
Subject: Starry Preview — Enrollment Confirmed
Hi Team,
You're confirmed for the Starry preview cohort. Attached: pre-read + invite. Reply if you need to reschedule.
Thanks,
Alex
```

jeff: I'll also attach the troubleshooting doc to the invite and tag it in the pre-read.
maria: Recap / action items: alex nudges legal + sends confirmations; sam pre-read by EOD; jeff uploads doc into invite; I'll run enablement and assign 1:1s after legal clears. :rocket:
alex: Noted — pinging legal now. :thumbsup:
maria: Closing thread for now, will reopen if anything changes.
